sourceReview: Corrected the short window case by keeping all viewport height and moving controls into overlays below 300 DIP.
frameReview: Windowed image edges remain visible with the filmstrip open. The model grid and primary action are aligned. A uniform backdrop makes the glass look closer to matte than a textured backdrop does.
tradeoff: The filmstrip reserves height in windowed mode. Fullscreen restores the whole viewport and auto-hides its glass controls.
scope: Blind synthetic frame review and native material/motion diagnostics. The motion probe exercises the actual viewer button template with synthetic controller state.
